issue_context.title: Modbus is unavailable after device reconnection
issue_context.body:
### The problem

If the connection with TCP modbus device is down, sensors got "unavailable" state despite of timeout settings and the device and sensors are not accessible until the HA is restarted.

I.e. I have a timeout of 600 sec. Link with modbus is down for 2 minutes but sensor goes to unavailable and not accessible again when the connection is restored. The same with the switches:

20:41 - link is down
20:42:30 - binary_sensor1 got "unavailable" state
20:44:15 - link is up
sensor in "unavailable" ...


### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.0b0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

modbus

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/modbus/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
- name: Guest_Bedroom
    type: tcp
    host: 192.168.1.11
    port: 502
    close_comm_on_error: false
    timeout: 600
#    retries: 9
    retry_on_empty: true

# test
    binary_sensors:
      - name: "binary_sensor1"
        address: 82
        scan_interval: 5
        slave: 1
```
